_: Rates behind every quote scripts/tickets.py produces. Edit freely; a quote records the rates it was computed with. A price is the PRINT price (filament + printer time + handling, with the margin, never below min_charge) plus a flat DESIGN fee that depends on how much design is new: 'none' for an existing design or a customer's own file, 'adapt' when an existing design or library components are fitted to the customer's object, 'new' when it is drawn from scratch. Quantity multiplies the print price only; the design fee is paid once.

none.label: Existing design, or your own file

adapt.label: An existing design or proven parts, fitted to your object
